verdict.rationale: Signifyd lists an Account Protection product ('Defend customer accounts') and Return Insights for return-related risk alongside its checkout fraud protection. That is a first-party claim of coverage beyond checkout, but it is only a one-line marketing mention. The API docs shown cover only checkout, sale, chargeback and decision events. missing for 10: documented account-takeover scoring, fake account creation detection, promo abuse detection, explicit policy-abuse scoring, evidence that these surfaces are scored and managed in the same Decision Center system as orders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, protection extends beyond checkout — account takeover, fake account creation, promo and policy abuse are scored and managed in the same system
